notizie.titolo: $1 Million In QQQ Spent 503 Days Underwater
notizie.riassunto: Tech funds are well off their highs this autumn. QQQ closed at $656.95 on Tuesday, Nov 17. That is 13.5% below its high close on Oct 6. Most of the talk is about whether the AI trade is over. This article asks a different question. What did five years in QQQ actually feel like, in dollars.

notizie.titolo: Two Retirees Each Hold $500,000 in a 401(k) Index Fund as Nvidia’s CFO Takes the Wheel. One Has About $28,950 Riding on a Single Stock. The Other Has About $1,000
notizie.riassunto: Nvidia's founder just walked out, and two retirees with identical 401(k) balances face wildly different risk. The fix costs nothing in taxes, but one tempting panic move could trigger a cascade of hidden costs on Social Security and Medicare.
